---
- name: Configure node1 (VyOS) as the inter-VLAN router on the shared trunk link
  hosts: router

  vars:
    trunk_iface: eth1
  tasks:
    - name: Create VLAN10/VLAN20 gateway sub-interfaces on the trunk link
      ansible.builtin.shell: |
        source /opt/vyatta/etc/functions/script-template
        configure
        set interfaces ethernet {{ trunk_iface }} vif 10 address 10.10.10.1/24
        set interfaces ethernet {{ trunk_iface }} vif 20 address 10.10.20.1/24
        commit
        save
        exit
      args:
        executable: /bin/bash
      register: vyos_config
      changed_when: "'No configuration changes to commit' not in vyos_config.stdout"
      failed_when: vyos_config.rc != 0 or 'failed' in vyos_config.stdout | lower

    - name: Show VyOS interface state
      ansible.builtin.command: /opt/vyatta/bin/vyatta-op-cmd-wrapper show interfaces
      register: vyos_ifaces
      changed_when: false

    - name: Print VyOS interfaces
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        var: vyos_ifaces.stdout_lines

- name: Move node2 and node3 onto tagged VLANs over the shared trunk link
  hosts: rhel
  gather_facts: yes
  vars:
    trunk_iface: enp8s0
  tasks:
    - name: Remove the default DHCP profile competing for the trunk NIC
      community.general.nmcli:
        conn_name: "{{ trunk_conn_default }}"
        state: absent

    - name: Bring up the trunk NIC itself with no IP address (VLAN tags only)
      community.general.nmcli:
        type: ethernet
        conn_name: "{{ trunk_iface }}"
        ifname: "{{ trunk_iface }}"
        method4: disabled
        method6: disabled
        autoconnect: yes
        state: present

    - name: Create the tagged VLAN sub-interface with its VLAN gateway route
      community.general.nmcli:
        type: vlan
        conn_name: "{{ trunk_iface }}.{{ vlan_id }}"
        ifname: "{{ trunk_iface }}.{{ vlan_id }}"
        vlandev: "{{ trunk_iface }}"
        vlanid: "{{ vlan_id }}"
        ip4: "{{ vlan_cidr }}"
        method4: manual
        routes4:
          - "{{ peer_net }} {{ peer_gw }}"
        autoconnect: yes
        state: present

    - name: Activate the trunk parent connection
      ansible.builtin.command: nmcli connection up "{{ trunk_iface }}"
      changed_when: true

    - name: Activate the VLAN connection
      ansible.builtin.command: nmcli connection up "{{ trunk_iface }}.{{ vlan_id }}"
      changed_when: true

    - name: Trust the VLAN interface in firewalld so routed inter-VLAN traffic passes
      ansible.posix.firewalld:
        zone: trusted
        interface: "{{ trunk_iface }}.{{ vlan_id }}"
        permanent: yes
        immediate: yes
        state: enabled

- name: Verify the two systems can reach each other across node1's routed VLANs
  hosts: node2
  gather_facts: no
  tasks:
    - name: Ping node3's VLAN20 address (10.10.20.12) via node1
      ansible.builtin.command: ping -c 4 -W 2 10.10.20.12
      register: ping_forward
      changed_when: false

    - name: Show forward ping result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        var: ping_forward.stdout_lines
EOF
